semiconductor_relevance: High — Bronkhorst Taiwan Co., Ltd. specializes in flow measurement and control instruments critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Bronkhorst Taiwan Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures high-quality thermal and Coriolis instruments for measuring and dosing the flow of gases and liquids, essential for semiconductor fabrication. With over 40 years of experience, they provide mass flow and pressure meters/controllers that support various applications in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Mass flow meters/controllers for gas and liquid
Leak detection systems for vacuum or gas
Cleaning and drying equipment for substrates

regional_presence.Taiwan: Bronkhorst has a professional team in Taiwan to serve local customers.
